notes.title: Next Fest - Dev Live Stream + Q&A, Hues of the Void
notes.content:
Watch our live play-through of the Demo while we set some High Scores!ːsteamhappyː

Combining color matching, line defence, and some random puzzle elements, [b]Hues of the Void[/b] is a unique and engaging take on the “x-defense” game genre.

Within these prismatic lands, you must defend yourself against the advancing knights of an oppressive theocratic order - The Chromacrusade!
 
During the stream we'll show you a few tips and tricks to help you master the void.
We'll also be answering questions and listening to player feedback.

Add our game your wishlist, and the free demo to your library today!
